correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Alexander tableau and stability function; computed all spectral-projector entries for each unit star. Proved nonnegativity of every offdiagonal entry using a polynomial with positive coefficients, so exact positivity reduces to two diagonal scalar functions. Minimum of the scalar stability function gives sharp leaf-count four cutoff; hub quadratic has exactly two positive roots from count five onward; the leaf quartic has exactly two positive roots by a proved coefficient-sign pattern, a negative exact witness, and positive endpoint limits. Exact inequalities at steps 7/2 and 17/5 give the disjoint-versus-overlap cutoff nine/ten. Supplemental stdlib verifier replays algebraic checks. No inference from finite experiments to all m.

value.rationale: Unweighted stars are a natural diffusion test family with a high-degree junction. The two independent diagonal-sign obstructions and exact merger at ten leaves identify when an L-stable second-order integrator violates a discrete maximum principle despite mass conservation and eventual end-step positivity; these are structural all-degree phase boundaries, not a routine isolated counterexample. Exact root formulas give implementable timestep exclusion intervals and distinguish stiffness damping from positivity. No broader graph or stagewise claim is made.
